title: Presbyterian Church Mobile, Hanging Exhibit - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A deckle-edged snapshot from July 1957 documenting an elaborate hanging paper mobile or geometric installation at a Presbyterian church gathering or exhibition inside a large gym or hall. The paper cylinders, cubes, and triangular lanterns are inscribed with slogans highlighting church organization: 'Representing more than 8,500 Churches', 'Board of Christian Education', 'Theological Education', 'Our Fellowship Synod', 'Presbytery', and a map of the United States featuring a Christian cross alongside the word 'Christian'. Posters on boards in the background indicate themes like 'Evangelism'.
